concerns.text: T060a and T060b are both tagged [P] but are NOT parallel-safe: they mutate the SAME files (code/ and tests/). Running flake8 fixes and black reformatting concurrently on shared source files is a write-write race. Moreover, black's reformatting can introduce new flake8 findings (line-length/w503-style conflicts), so the flake8-clean verification in T060a is only valid AFTER T060b's reformat is applied. Either serialize them (T060b then T060a, or one combined task) or drop the [P] tag and state the required order.
